focal_response.selection_basis: pre-response ecological breadth across US forest systems; not dataset prevalence
focal_response.eligible_unit: one deployment row with valid deployment_id, coordinates, start_date and end_date
focal_response.binary_rule: 1 if at least one sequence row for the same deployment has exact scientific name Odocoileus virginianus; otherwise 0

worlds.local_threshold_algorithm: compute all finite pairwise distances among the 814 response-blind unique coordinate nodes; use empirical quantiles q10,q25,q50,q75 as four local thresholds, computed before reading response rows inside the once-only runner
worlds.support_rule: for a positive source deployment and target deployment, local-world support is 1 if haversine distance <= that world's frozen threshold and 0 otherwise; external_open support is 1
worlds.survival_rule: all declared worlds remain in the prediction-facing candidate for this cross-sectional endpoint; exact Layer-A world IDs remain upstream and are not labels
worlds.source_projection: equal-weight source-symmetric aggregation across all positive source deployments available to the relevant fitting stage

layer_b_generation.inner_train_rows: cross-fit by excluding the focal deployment from the positive source set if it is positive; all other inner-train positives may be sources
layer_b_generation.outer_rows: after promotion decision, use all calibration positives from inner-train plus inner-validation

selector.metric: macro binary log loss across inner-validation subprojects
selector.rule: promote Layer B if and only if augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline inner-validation macro log loss; otherwise select baseline-only
selector.after_selection: refit baseline and augmented candidate on full calibration (inner-train plus inner-validation); score baseline, always-augmented and preselected arm on untouched outer-heldout subprojects

primary.metric: macro binary log loss across outer-heldout subprojects
primary.conservative_miss: baseline was preselected but always-augmented outer log loss is lower than baseline

secondary: inner-validation baseline and augmented macro log loss
class counts and number of both-class subprojects per partition

interpretive_boundary.known_truth_translation_to_real_improvem: preselected arm has strictly lower outer macro log loss than baseline
interpretive_boundary.protective_null_means: selector avoided forced Layer-B use but did not demonstrate real predictive improvement
interpretive_boundary.adverse_means: calibration-only selector promoted a representation that harmed untouched outer prediction
